# Argil Group

> Argil is an ISO-certified manufacturer of engineered quartz surfaces and SPC (Stone Plastic Composite) vinyl flooring, based in Morbi, Gujarat, India. The company manufactures and exports quartz slabs and SPC flooring for residential and commercial use, with 10+ years in the industry and international certifications including TISI (Thailand) and SLSI (Sri Lanka).

Argil serves architects, builders, interior designers, and distributors, supplying quartz countertop slabs and SPC flooring in 50+ designs. Manufacturing takes place at the company's own facility in Morbi, India, covering mixing, pressing, polishing, and quality control.

## Products

- [Quartz Surface](https://www.argiltiles.com/quartzsurface): Engineered quartz slabs for kitchen countertops, platforms, and commercial surfaces. Includes manufacturing process, product advantages, and FAQs.
- [SPC Flooring](https://www.argiltiles.com/spcproducts): Stone Plastic Composite flooring for residential and commercial spaces — waterproof, scratch-resistant, click-lock installation.
- [Catalogue](https://www.argiltiles.com/catalogue): Full downloadable product catalogue.
